title: Yellow Crispy Ethiopian Haggis Wrap
description: A pungent and crispy Ethiopian dish featuring haggis, steamed and wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian friendly meal.

ingredients.name: haggis
ingredients.notes: traditional Scottish dish made from sheep heart, liver, and lungs, mixed with onions, oatmeal, and spices

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the corn husks in water for at least 30 minutes to make them pliable.
In a pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and cook for another minute.
Add the haggis to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is lightly browned.
Stir in the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat and spoon some of the haggis mixture onto the center of the husk.
Top the haggis with a dollop of yogurt and fold the corn husk over the filling to form a tight bundle.
Place the wraps on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional yogurt and berbere spice if desired.
